    driver-class-name: com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
    url: jdbc:mysql://${DB_HOST:localhost}:${DB_PORT:3306}/craft_market_booth?useUnicode=true&characterEncoding=utf-8&useSSL=false&serverTimezone=Asia/Shanghai

  servlet:

      max-file-size: 10MB
      max-request-size: 10MB
  
  # 模板引擎配置（虽然不需要前端，但保留以备不时之需）
  thymeleaf:
    cache: false
    encoding: UTF-8
    mode: HTML

mybatis-plus:
  configuration:
    map-underscore-to-camel-case: true
    cache-enabled: false
    call-setters-on-nulls: true
    jdbc-type-for-null: null

    db-config:

      logic-delete-field: deleted
      logic-delete-value: 1
      logic-not-delete-value: 0

    max-size: 100
